name: litgpt (pretrain)
summary: Truncated reproduction of the litgpt pretrain path: pythia-14m, 8 optimizer steps on WikiText-2 via the TextFiles data module. The training code reproduced exactly - the loss trajectory was bit-identical across three independent environments at seed 42 - and the published lineage re-runs cold on a GPU-less machine (4/4 steps, same checkpoint, same val loss). Every obstacle was in packaging rather than in the model: litgpt download raises AttributeError on huggingface_hub >= 1.0 while litgpt's own pin permits it; torchmetrics and litdata are imported unconditionally on the pretrain path but declared only as optional extras; the pinned litdata==0.2.59 drags an unbounded torchvision that hard-pins an exact torch, silently replacing a curated PyTorch; and wandb/mlflow are advertised logger choices that appear in no dependency group. No litgpt source file was modified. Held short of a full published record pending one internal record check on the tokenization step.
